title: 海洋繫留觀測站
summary: 把繫留站浮力、受力、供電、採樣和資料缺口整合成長期觀測證據鏈。 在海洋繫留站資料與能量室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Integrate buoyancy, loads, energy, sampling and data gaps into long-term moored-observatory evidence. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Moored-observatory data/energy laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 浮標與負載的淨浮力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Buoy net buoyancy and payload: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 浮標與負載的淨浮力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Buoy net buoyancy and payload and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「海洋繫留觀測站」的「浮標與負載的淨浮力」中，淨浮力是排水重與自身重的差，符號決定靜水趨勢。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：把繫留站浮力、受力、供電、採樣和資料缺口整合成長期觀測證據鏈。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ocean moored observatories, Buoy net buoyancy and payload examines this mechanism: Net buoyancy is displaced-water weight minus self-weight; its sign sets the static tendency. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Integrate buoyancy, loads, energy, sampling and data gaps into long-term moored-observatory evidence.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρwater=1025 kg/m³，ρmaterial=600 kg/m³，V=0.02 m³。關係式 Fnet=(ρw−ρm)gV；含單位換算算式 (1025-600)*9.81*0.02 = 83.385 N。適用條件：不含壓縮、吸水或深度循環；不能當材料耐深認證。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Water density 1025 kg/m³, material density 600 kg/m³ and volume 0.02 m³. Relation Fnet=(ρw−ρm)gV; expression including unit conversion (1025-600)*9.81*0.02 = 83.385 N. Applicability: Excludes compression, water uptake and depth cycling; not depth certification.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：吸水增加質量但未同步更改浮力帳會高估餘裕。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Water uptake without updating mass accounting overestimates buoyancy reserve. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「浮標與負載的淨浮力」，分列乾重、吸水後重與體積變化，不把密度當常數。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Buoy net buoyancy and payload, Separate dry/wet mass and volume change rather than assuming constant density. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.text: 在「浮標與負載的淨浮力」比較基準算式 (1025-600)*9.81*0.02 與替代算式 (1025-700)*9.81*0.02。先圈出唯一變動的輸入並預測增減，再計算 63.765 N，與基準 83.385 N 比較。保存輸入、單位、兩個輸出與一項不能外推的結論；只在數位模型或紙上進行。

Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 63.765 N, versus baseline 83.385 N. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「海洋繫留觀測站」的「浮標與負載的淨浮力：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Buoy net buoyancy and payload: Mechanism and observation” in “Ocean moored observatories”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Current loading and mooring resultant and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「海洋繫留觀測站」的「海流受力與繫留合力」中，準靜態定位需使水平力合力接近零，還須另滿足力矩平衡。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：把繫留站浮力、受力、供電、採樣和資料缺口整合成長期觀測證據鏈。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ocean moored observatories, Current loading and mooring resultant examines this mechanism: Quasistatic station keeping requires near-zero horizontal resultant and separate moment balance. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Integrate buoyancy, loads, energy, sampling and data gaps into long-term moored-observatory evidence.

Applicability: Planar resultant illustration, not vessel DP configuration or control commands.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：合力為零但作用點不對仍可產生旋轉。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。

knowledge.textEn: For Current loading and mooring resultant, compare baseline expression (400**2+300**2)**0.5 with alternative (500**2+300**2)**0.5. Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 583.095189 N, versus baseline 500 N. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
只把總推力加大就能解決所有定位誤差。
本單元先檢查以下替代原因：合力為零但作用點不對仍可產生旋轉。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Increasing total thrust solves every station-keeping error.
First examine this alternative cause: Zero resultant with displaced application points can still create rotation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：合力為零但作用點不對仍可產生旋轉。 對「海流受力與繫留合力」，畫推力向量與作用點，將偏航力矩另列一式。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
quiz.explanationEn: First examine this alternative cause: Zero resultant with displaced application points can still create rotation. For Current loading and mooring resultant, Draw thrust vectors and application points; write yaw balance separately. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
